name: agent-native-turn-into-app
description: Turn visible project context, a proven thread, skill, or workflow into a runnable Agent-Native app. On Claude or ChatGPT Web, it hands a bounded source brief to Builder through Dispatch; local code agents can build and verify in a workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Turn visible project context, a proven thread, skill, or workflow into a runnable Agent-Native app. On Claude or ChatGPT Web, it hands a bounded source brief to Builder through Dispatch; local code agents can build and verify in a workspace.
interface.longDescription: Turn Into App packages agent instructions, app actions, an MCP connector, and inline UI surfaces as an installable skill. The plugin connects to hosted Turn Into App by default; use the Agent-Native CLI when you need a custom/self-hosted app URL.
defaultPrompt: Open Turn Into App where useful
Use Turn Into App for app-backed workflows
Search Turn Into App and return usable context
